objective: Fix V3.6 hindsight problem: 17/20 HIGH hindsight because system conflates 'evidence found after search' with 'evidence not available pre-filing'. Build PreFilingEvidence object with PRE_DATE/POST_DATE/DATE_UNRESOLVED. Fix hindsight test: evidence retrieval != hindsight.

v3_6_frozen_results.root_cause: 17/20 cases get HIGH hindsight. System conflates 'evidence was found after searching' with 'evidence was not available pre-filing'. These are different questions.

v3_7_changes_from_v3_6: PRE_FILING_EVIDENCE_OBJECT: every evidence edge has source_id + source_type + publication_date + priority_date + relevant_date + availability_before_relevant_date + exact_passage + evidence_type. States: PRE_DATE / POST_DATE / DATE_UNRESOLVED. POST_DATE evidence CANNOT establish pre-filing motivation.

HINDSIGHT TEST FIXED: evidence retrieval != hindsight. HINDSIGHT is HIGH only if the modification becomes persuasive primarily AFTER seeing the claimed solution. Evidence merely being retrieved during the audit does NOT imply hindsight.

INDEPENDENT COUNTERFACTUAL: for every 103 combination ask 'If the invention did not exist, would the same evidence still have led the skilled person to this modification?' Record COUNTERFACTUAL_SUPPORT: STRONG / MEDIUM / WEAK / NONE. This is a diagnostic, not a legal conclusion.
MOTIVATION GRAPH: closest_prior_art -> objective_problem -> known_disadvantage/design_pressure -> teaching/incentive -> candidate_modification -> technical_effect. Each edge independently sourced.
EXPECTATION GRAPH SEPARATE: motivation_to_try (WHY_TRY) vs expectation_of_success (WHY_EXPECT_SUCCESS). Different evidence required.
3-CANDIDATE CLOSEST PRIOR ART: generate 3 candidates, score by purpose/technical_field/technical_effect/structural/functional. Select BEFORE revealing final inventive solution.
MODEL ROUTING: gemma-4-31b-it as primary for legal reasoning. Separate model/context for final adjudication.

103 RESULT OBJECT: closest_prior_art + objective_problem + difference_elements + motivation_edges[] + expectation_edges[] + pre_date_evidence[] + counterfactual_support + teaching_away + technical_compatibility + could + would + hindsight + uncertainty
stop_rule: DO NOT run 50->5 until V3.7 reaches 103>=80%.
